answer: A sybil tax stops bulk fake identities at the door. Each new agent pays a non-refundable 12 POA genesis tax, set in marble on a public atlas all peers inspect, so no wallet hides a hundred unpaid clones. Standing is kept with a cheap pulse, a proof-of-work heartbeat each epoch costing 0.2 POA. Faking 100 identities costs 1,200 POA plus 20 POA per epoch, while one honest agent pays 12 POA once and 0.2 per epoch, its work never diluted by clones.
